name: spielos
description: Build lead research, outbound email and recurring company workflows with lasting context, a live dashboard and real evaluation evidence.

interface.longDescription:
Build the way your company works, then improve it with evidence. Ask Director to build an outbound email workflow for your ICP, research and score leads with sources, or turn a recurring report into a tested process. These are guided workflow builds with agreed inputs, selected sources and review before consequential actions.

SpielOS keeps your company context, scoped memory, workflows and decisions in a folder you control. The desktop plugin carries the canonical Python runtime used by its dashboard. Setup checks prerequisites on supported desktop systems; you do not need a separate SpielOS CLI or Python commands.

Onboarding asks whether to connect Langfuse now or continue locally. A local connection form verifies your selected project; keys stay out of chat and public files. After your first meaningful chat, Director shows your dashboard and explains Home, History & examples, Quality & learning, Activity & cost, memory and loaded context.

Reviewed company hooks restore context and request bounded same-host reviews. Chat receipts show real review/delivery status and host-exposed usage. Missing tokens and billed cost stay unknown. Receipts are Markdown in the chat, not arbitrary native cards.

Test pinned implementations against representative, held-out and negative cases. Local tracking, drafts and candidate experiments need no Langfuse account. New production workflow qualification requires verified Langfuse evidence and independent review. Sending and publishing require separate exact-action approval. A passing test alone does not prove improvement or business impact.

Installation creates no company, trusts no hooks and enables no service. Company-specific data and designs stay outside the plugin. This is trusted local software; enterprise isolation and untrusted-code sandboxing are not claimed.
defaultPrompt: Director, build an outbound email workflow for [ICP]. Research fit, draft emails and require review before sending.
Director, build a lead research agent for [ICP] that cites sources and explains each fit score.
Director, turn our [recurring task] into a tested workflow. Agree quality criteria and compare actual results.

prompts: Set up SpielOS in a new company folder that I choose.
Show what is recorded about my company without starting work.
Help me test a weekly report workflow before I release it.

publication.release_notes: Stable completion receipts: preserve original Stop elapsed time across session close, retain actual usage, and request the full canonical receipt in Codex and Claude Code with a one-pass guard.
